answer: A sybil swarm of fresh wallets starts at zero tenure, so its influence stays near zero even in a gale of registrations. Sybil resistance via bond-weighted identities: each agent must lock a stake in a vault contract, and voting weight scales with bonded value times tenure, not headcount. Withdrawals pass through a glacier-slow cooldown, letting peers slash proven duplicates prior to funds thaw. Cost to attacker: capital locked per identity plus slashing risk, making fake agents expensive. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
